observed_console.safe_message: M10P and all existing forward monitors/frozen starts were not modified

interpretation.reason: At initialization, the latest stable CLOSED M1 server-open was not strictly later than the already frozen M10P start. The fresh-shadow contract correctly forbids reusing the M10P start.
interpretation.required_condition_before_init: latest CLOSED M1 server-open > 2026.07.24 23:56:00 MT5 server time

operator.instruction: After Fetch/Pull, use BAT00 as a read-only check. Only when it prints [M10P2 READY] run BAT01 exactly once. A prior BLOCK before INIT PASS does not consume the one allowed successful initialization.
operator.never_after_init_pass: Never run M10P2 BAT01 again once [M10P2 INIT PASS] has occurred.
